title: Check Engine Light Flashing
summary: Common causes, likely diagnostic paths, OBD references, and repair-next steps when the check engine light is flashing.
intro: A flashing check engine light usually means an active misfire severe enough to risk catalytic converter damage. Treat it as a drivability problem first, then separate whether the miss is isolated to one cylinder or tied to a shared ignition, fuel, or airflow problem.
common_sounds: Heavy shaking or bucking under load
Sharp stumble or cylinder drop at idle
Raw fuel smell from the exhaust
Noticeable power loss while the light is flashing
quick_checks: Avoid heavy driving until the active misfire is identified
Scan immediately for P0300 through P0304 and any related fuel-trim codes
Inspect spark plugs, ignition coils, and coil boots first on the affected cylinder
Check injector operation if the same cylinder keeps dropping out
Verify whether the misfire is random or tied to one cylinder before replacing parts
common_causes: Faulty fuel injector on one cylinder
Shared airflow or vacuum leak issue
Rich or lean operation severe enough to trigger misfire
diagnostic_paths: If a cylinder-specific code is present, start with plug and coil swap testing before moving deeper.
If P0300 is active, shared ignition, fuel-delivery, and airflow checks matter more than single-cylinder guesses.
If catalyst-efficiency codes appear later, diagnose the upstream misfire cause before condemning the converter.

recommended_repairs.title: Spark Plug Replacement Cost
recommended_repairs.description: A common first repair path when the active misfire is tied to worn or fouled plugs.

recommended_repairs.title: Ignition Coil Replacement Cost
recommended_repairs.description: Relevant when the misfire follows the coil or ignition output is clearly weak under load.

recommended_repairs.title: Fuel Injector Replacement Cost
recommended_repairs.description: A strong next path when one cylinder stays dead after ignition checks and injector testing points to fuel control.

recommended_repairs.title: Catalytic Converter Replacement Cost
recommended_repairs.description: Only price this after the active misfire or fueling problem is diagnosed so the replacement converter is not damaged again.
